GenAiFunction.description: Renders a generic, caller-driven ranked/prioritized table. Pass a JSON `spec` describing optional title/subtitle/badges, an optional summary callout, the `columns` (key/header/align) and `rows` (an id plus a value per column key), optional `highlights` (iconName/iconColor/title/detail) and an optional CTA. The action flattens the keyed rows into typed, column-ordered cells the card renders. Call with no spec to show a portable demo pipeline.
